title: LIFX Firmware Skew by Group
app: Aqara, IKEA Tradfri, LIFX, Nanoleaf, Shelly, Zigbee2MQTT, Ecobee, and smart blind motors via vendor clouds, LAN APIs, MQTT bridges, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifx:state
| stats latest(firmware_version) as firmware_version by group bulb
| eventstats dc(firmware_version) as firmware_variants by group
| where firmware_variants>1
| sort - firmware_variants
description: Uses LIFX bulb state telemetry to monitor firmware skew inside each lighting group in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for partial upgrades that complicate troubleshooting, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest LIFX bulb state data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Group inventory of LIFX firmware variants.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals firmware skew inside each lighting group so you can spot partial upgrades that complicate troubleshooting before it becomes annoying.
